people: Han emperor who climbed Qian Mountain and named it the Southern Marchmount

claims.event: Climbed Qian Mountain to sacrifice at Tianzhu and proclaimed it the Southern Marchmount [External dating, inferred: Emperor Wu of Han reigned 141–87 BC per the standard Han reign table; the treatise recalls his act without a date.]

claims.statement: Climbed Qian Mountain, performed rites at Tianzhu and proclaimed it the Southern Marchmount
